title: Karma Automotive President Marques McCammon to Share Perspective on Innovation Leadership at Greater Irvine Chamber's Innovator's Journey
snippet: Complementing McCammon's executive perspective, Errol Arkilic, Chief Innovation Officer at UC Irvine and Executive Director of UCI Beall Applied Innovation, will share insights from his pioneering work commercializing university research and founding the National Science Foundation's Innovation Corps (I-Corps) program. Together, the two leaders will offer attendees a rare opportunity to hear both
match_reason: websearch (publication) — Errol Arkilic is featured as the keynote speaker for the upcoming Innovator's Journey event, which focuses on innovation in technology, healthcare, and artificial intelligence.
